title: Implement vocabulary checks in the diagnose pipeline
description: Add the unapproved-word and one-meaning-per-word check heuristics to src/limatus/editorial_diagnosis.py following the _check_* function pattern, gated by the new checks keys, honoring profile lexicon prefer/avoid interactions like _rules_term_conflicts_with_lexicon does.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in src/limatus/editorial_diagnosis.py: _check_asd_vocabulary (unapproved words with approved alternatives, technical-name span occupation) and _check_asd_multi_meaning (part-of-speech heuristics: article-prefixed noun usage vs sentence-initial imperative/modal verb usage), gated by disabledRules approvedWords/oneMeaningPerWord. 14 unit tests in tests/test_asd_ste100_vocabulary.py.
